Our client is a leading industrial manufacturing company investing in the expansion and modernization of one of its production sites.

Jobomschrijving

• Coordinate engineering activities from concept and feasibility studies through execution.

• Excellent coordination and communication skills, with the ability to work across multiple stakeholders.

Company Activities:

Our client is part of the circular economy based on wood fibers. In Belgium, the company has three units employing around 600 employees. The plant in Langerbrugge (Ghent) produces high-quality newspaper and magazine paper from 100% recycled paper. Thanks to two biomass power plants that provide the necessary process steam and three wind turbines, the company is one of the most sustainable enterprises in North Sea Port. Safety is the top priority, and thanks to intensive training programs, employees develop both professionally and personal

Jobomschrijving

Our client, a leading global producer of renewable solutions for paper, packaging, pulp, and wood constructions, is looking for an Electrical Maintenance Technician. In this role, you will be responsible for managing and maintaining the electrical network up to a voltage level of 150 kV.

Your daily tasks will include:
	
• Managing the lighting network.	
• Maintaining fire detection systems.	
• Operating frequency converters (ABB, Siemens, Danfoss).	
• Controlling various types of power switches (Siemens, ABB).

The ideal candidate should:
	
• Hold a Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent experience.	
• Have several years of experience in a similar role in an industrial production environment.	
• Be passionate about electricity and keep up-to-date with the latest trends in the field.	
• Think pragmatically and solve problems.	
• Plan and organize work effectively, with a focus on achieving results.	
• Communicate in English or Dutch at a good level.

As a machine operator in our modern citrus department, you play a crucial role in operating and optimizing automated production and packaging lines. You use MES software to monitor and improve the performance of machines and production lines. Together with your team, you ensure a smooth workflow and high-quality end products.

Your day consists of setting up, adjusting, and operating machines, timely providing materials, and guiding colleagues on the line. You work closely with the technical department in case of malfunctions and regularly perform minor maintenance tasks. Additionally, you register production data and help maintain order and cleanliness in the workplace.

Are you a team player who likes to take initiative and think about improvements? Do you want to work in a growing department within a stable company? Apply now and discover your opportunities as a machine operator in our citrus department!

• At least lower secondary education
• Experience as an operator is required (0-1 year welcome)
• Good knowledge of English (spoken and written)
• Willingness to work in a two-shift system (sometimes three shifts) and weekends
• Team-oriented and communicative
• Accurate and safety-conscious
• Proactive and solution-oriented

Our client is an innovative SME located in the Maldegem region, specialising in the design, development and installation of high-tech test and measurement equipment for the agricultural sector. Their tailor-made solutions are used worldwide by machine manufacturers, universities and testing centres to accurately test, measure and optimise agricultural machinery. By combining engineering, machine building and automation, they deliver customised projects for customers across the globe.

Jobomschrijving

As a Project Engineer Machine Building, you will be involved in the complete development of innovative machines and testing systems. From the initial concept to the final installation at the customer's site, you will play an active role throughout the entire project lifecycle. This is a varied position combining engineering, assembly, testing and international commissioning.

As a Project Engineer Machine Building, your responsibilities include:

• Developing and improving new machines and technical solutions.
• Building, assembling and testing prototypes.
• Installing, commissioning and fine-tuning equipment at customer sites both nationally and internationally.
• Analysing technical issues and proposing improvements to products and processes.
• Preparing technical documentation, manuals and work instructions.
• Collaborating closely with colleagues from engineering, production and service departments.
• Providing technical support during demonstrations, trade fairs and commercial activities.

For this positFor this position as Project Engineer Machine Building, we are looking for an all-round engineer who enjoys combining theory with hands-on technical work. You like taking ownership of projects from start to finish and are willing to travel internationally on a regular basis.

As a Project Engineer Machine Building, you have:

• A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electromechanics, Mechanical Engineering, Product Development, Machine Building or a related technical field.
• A strong interest in machine building, automation and product development.
• A hands-on mentality and practical approach to engineering.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Willingness to travel internationally for installations and commissioning projects.
• A good command of English.
• Knowledge of Dutch is mandatory.
• A valid Category B driving licence.

About the Company:

Our client, headquartered in Zwijnaarde, is a leading global biotechnology company introducing groundbreaking cell therapy to Ghent. Their dedicated team plays a crucial role in improving the lives of patients battling cancer and other severe illnesses. As they continue to grow, they are looking for motivated and committed individuals to join their dynamic workforce.

Jobomschrijving

For our client, an innovative and rapidly expanding biotech company, we are currently seeking a Warehouse Associate.

Responsibilities:

As a Warehouse Associate, you will be responsible for:
	
• Handling biohazard materials such as blood bags and viral vectors in a temperature-controlled environment.	
• Accurately processing incoming inventory by verifying purchase orders, conducting quality checks, and ensuring compliance with company policies.	
• Managing equipment and materials stored at cryogenic temperatures.	
• Completing Master Inspection Checks (MIC) for received goods, including transportation inspections, temperature control, integrity verification, and proper documentation.	
• Filling in necessary forms and logbooks related to receiving, picking, and outbound operations in accordance with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and Good Documentation Practices (GDP).	
• Collaborating closely with the Operations and Quality departments to facilitate production and laboratory activities at the start-up site.	
• Working in a sterile environment while wearing specialized protective clothing.	
• Using two SAP Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems to manage inbound, picking, and outbound logistics.	
• Coordinating with accounting, suppliers, and business stakeholders to enhance operational efficiency.

Candidate Profile:
	
• High school diploma or associate’s degree.	
• Prior warehouse experience, preferably within the pharmaceutical industry.	
• Strong attention to detail with the ability to complete administrative tasks such as filling out forms and maintaining logbooks.	
• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively across various levels of the organization.	
• Problem-solving mindset with solid analytical and data interpretation skills.	
• Strict adherence to protocols to ensure product quality and personal safety at all times.	
• Ability to work independently while maintaining a high level of responsibility.	
• Proficiency in English is essential.

Our client, company founded in 1948, is a Belgian family business specializing in exterior joinery. Their  Group covers a range of production units. The business unit Extrusion & Finishing extrudes, anodizes and enamels aluminum profiles. Our client specializes in custom-made exterior joinery in PVC, aluminum and wood. In addition to windows and doors, many additional products are also made, such as garage doors, roller shutters and ventilation systems.

Jobomschrijving

Job Description:

Without solid maintenance, there is no quality! As a maintenance technician, you will be responsible for monitoring wear and tear, tracking faults, analyzing causes, proposing solutions, and optimizing production processes. Your tasks will include:

• Risk analysis.	
• Working with top-quality machines and equipment.
By collaborating with external partners, you will have the opportunity to critically assess our client’s processes and advise management and production personnel on improving their machinery park. Working in their team also means continuous development, both individually and as part of a team

Candidate Profile:

• Teamwork and communication skills.	
• Openness to participating in the on-call system.

YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL
 Join BNP Paribas Fortis' AI Tribe, a team of 90+ AI experts driving innovation across the bank through advanced analytics and Artificial Intelligence.

As a Data Scientist specialized in Fraud Detection, you will design and deploy cutting-edge AI solutions to combat evolving financial crime threats. Combining machine learning, graph analytics, and Generative AI, you will transform data into actionable intelligence that helps protect our customers, strengthen the bank's resilience, and shape the future of fraud prevention.

 

AND IN DETAIL

As a Data Scientist specialized in Fraud Detection, you'll design, build, and deploy AI solutions to help protect our bank and customers from evolving fraud threats. You'll work within our AI Tribe and collaborate with Fraud Operations, Risk, and Compliance teams to transform data into actionable fraud prevention and detection capabilities.

What You'll Do

• Develop and enhance fraud detection models using machine learning, anomaly detection, behavioral analytics, and graph analytics.
• Analyze large-scale transactional and behavioral data to uncover suspicious patterns and emerging fraud schemes.
• Engineer features, enrich datasets, and apply a data-centric and error-analysis approach to continuously improve model performance.
• Partner with cross-functional teams to translate business needs into scalable AI solutions.
• Investigate complex fraud cases, identify emerging attack vectors, and proactively mitigate risks.
• Leverage advanced AI techniques (traditional machine learning and also LLMs and Generative AI), to support fraud investigations and strengthen fraud prevention capabilities.
• Stay ahead of AI and fraud trends to continuously enhance our detection and prevention strategies.
 

 

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

Education & Experience

• Master’s in Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science, or related field (PhD a plus).
• 3+ years in Data Science, preferably in financial services/fraud detection.
• Experience with fraud analytics, AML, or financial crime prevention.
 

Technical Skills

• Data-Centric AI & Data Engineering: Data collection, labeling, curation, enrichment, feature engineering, data quality, feedback, and large-scale data processing. 
• AI & Fraud Analytics:
• Machine Learning: Supervised and unsupervised learning for anomaly and fraud detection, model evaluation, performance monitoring, and error analysis.
• Advanced Analytics: Graph analytics, network analytics, behavioral analytics, and financial crime analytics.
• Generative AI & Foundation Models: LLMs, RAG, AI agents, deep learning , transactional model and AI-driven fraud prevention solutions.
• Programming & AI Engineering: Advanced Python, software engineering best practices, AI application development and deployment, monitoring, and end-to-end AI lifecycle management. 
 

Soft Skills

• Analytical, proactive, and results-driven.
• Strong communicator who thrives in multidisciplinary teams.
• Comfortable in an international, fast-paced environment.
 

Languages

• Fluent English + Dutch or French (professional level).
